lines.t: I was a vessel broken, poured out on the ground,
All I built in my strength had fallen down.
The storm of my ways left ruin behind,
Yet You came in the silence and opened my blind eyes.
You whispered, “Come, My child, to the place of still waters,”
“My mercy flows freely, for you are My treasure.”
YahuShua, my Healer, my Help, my Light,
You restore the pieces and make them right.
Counselor of comfort, my soul’s true Friend,
You breathe new life — I am whole again.
You searched the depths where sorrow hides,
And spoke peace where I could only cry.
Your truth pierced through my shadowed mind,
Revealing the love I could never define.
Now Your voice resounds like thunder and flame,
Yet wrapped in mercy, calling my name.
YahuShua, my Healer, my Help, my Light,
You restore the pieces and make them right.
Counselor of comfort, my soul’s true Friend,
You breathe new life — I am whole again.
In the valley of ashes, You whisper, “Rise.”
Your hands rebuild where the ruin lies.
No wound too deep, no heart too torn,
For in Your love, I am reborn.
YahuShua, my Healer, my Hope, my Guide,
You lift me high where grace abides.
Spirit of Truth, breathe through this clay,
You are my inspiration, my endless day.
All that I am, You’ve written anew,
In mercy and power, I’m made through You.
Broken no longer — forever restored,
YahuShua my Savior, forever adored.
